The Router correctly identified untestable checkpoints regarding the handle and bottom due to framing. I agree with all `is_testable` judgments.

The `topology_boundary_auditor` gave a high confidence score for the pan mask, suggesting the main subject is structurally coherent despite background issues. However, the Router may have underestimated the severity of the background collapse; the bowl merging into the table is a classic AI generation failure that disrupts scene realism. I will maintain the severity ratings but note that the background artifacts significantly impact overall quality.
